options.subtitle: Respuestas basadas en los datos registrados

parameters.jsCode: const q=String($json.chatInput??$json.message??'').trim(); const session=String($json.sessionId??'n8n-chat').slice(0,256); if(!q) return [{json:{question:'',kind:'rejected',session,errorResult:'RECHAZADA',errorAnswer:'La pregunta no puede estar vacía.'}}]; const s=q.toLocaleLowerCase('es'); let genreLabel=null; let genreCode=null; if(/\b(no binari[oa]s?|no_binario)\b/.test(s)){ genreLabel='No binario'; genreCode='NO_BINARIO'; } else if(/\b(prefiero no reportar|no reportad[oa]s?|sin reportar|prefiero_no_reportar)\b/.test(s)){ genreLabel='Prefiero no reportar'; genreCode='PREFIERO_NO_REPORTAR'; } else if(/\b(femenin[oa]s?|mujer(es)?)\b/.test(s)){ genreLabel='Femenino'; genreCode='FEMENINO'; } else if(/\b(masculin[oa]s?|hombre(s)?|var[oó]n(es)?)\b/.test(s)){ genreLabel='Masculino'; genreCode='MASCULINO'; } const hasCC=/\b(c[eé]dula(s)?( de ciudadan[ií]a)?|cc)\b/.test(s); const hasTI=/\b(tarjeta(s)? de identidad|ti)\b/.test(s); let docType=null; if(hasCC && !hasTI) docType='CC'; else if(hasTI && !hasCC) docType='TI'; const docMatch=s.match(/\b([0-9]{6,10})\b/); const docId=docMatch?docMatch[1]:null; let kind='semantic'; if(/\b(cu[aá]nt[oa]s?|n[uú]mero total|total de (personas|empleados|registros|mujeres|hombres)|conteo|cantidad de (personas|empleados|registros|mujeres|hombres))\b/.test(s)) kind='count'; else if(/\b(m[aá]s j[oó]ven(es)?|menor edad|menos edad|menos a[ñn]os)\b/.test(s)) kind='youngest'; else if(/\b(m[aá]s viej[oa]s?|m[aá]s ancian[oa]s?|m[aá]s longev[oa]s?|mayor edad|m[aá]s edad|m[aá]s a[ñn]os|persona mayor)\b/.test(s)) kind='oldest'; const wantsList=Boolean(genreLabel || docType || /\b(tod[oa]s|lista(r|do)?|qui[eé]nes|cu[aá]les|personas|registrad[oa]s)\b/.test(s)); const topK=docId?5:(wantsList?100:15); return [{json:{question:q,kind,session,genreLabel,genreCode,docType,docId,topK}}];

parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN $1::text IS NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS embedding_error, coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('content',v.content,'metadata',v.metadata)),'[]'::jsonb) AS context FROM (SELECT content,metadata FROM vector_person WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND ($2::text IS NULL OR content ILIKE ('%Género: ' || $2::text || '.%')) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR metadata->>'documentType' = $3::text) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR metadata->>'documentId' = $4::text) ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $5::integer) v;

WITH input AS (SELECT $1::text AS kind, $2::text AS genre_filter, $3::text AS doc_type_filter), filtered_person AS (SELECT p.* FROM person p, input i WHERE (i.genre_filter IS NULL OR p.genre::text = i.genre_filter) AND (i.doc_type_filter IS NULL OR p.documentType::text = i.doc_type_filter)), result AS (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total_personas',count(*)::integer,'filtro_genero',i.genre_filter,'filtro_tipo_documento',i.doc_type_filter) AS item FROM filtered_person p,input i WHERE i.kind='count' GROUP BY i.genre_filter,i.doc_type_filter UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('nombreCompleto',concat_ws(' ',p.firstName,p.secondName,p.lastNames),'firstName',p.firstName,'secondName',p.secondName,'lastNames',p.lastNames,'documentType',p.documentType,'documentId',p.documentId,'birthdate',p.birthdate,'edadAnos',EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date,p.birthdate))::integer,'genre',p.genre) FROM (SELECT * FROM filtered_person ORDER BY birthdate DESC,documentId ASC LIMIT 1) p,input i WHERE i.kind='youngest' UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('nombreCompleto',concat_ws(' ',p.firstName,p.secondName,p.lastNames),'firstName',p.firstName,'secondName',p.secondName,'lastNames',p.lastNames,'documentType',p.documentType,'documentId',p.documentId,'birthdate',p.birthdate,'edadAnos',EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date,p.birthdate))::integer,'genre',p.genre) FROM (SELECT * FROM filtered_person ORDER BY birthdate ASC,documentId ASC LIMIT 1) p,input i WHERE i.kind='oldest') SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(item),'[]'::jsonb) AS context FROM result;

parameters.jsCode: const cls=$('Clasificar pregunta').item.json; if(cls.kind==='rejected'){ return [{json:{result:'RECHAZADA',session:cls.session,question:cls.question,answer:cls.errorAnswer||'La pregunta no puede estar vacía.'}}]; } const rawAnswer=$json.message&&typeof $json.message.content==='string'?$json.message.content.trim():''; const failed=Boolean($json.retrievalFailed || $json.error || !rawAnswer); return [{json:{result:failed?'ERROR':'EXITO',session:cls.session,question:cls.question,answer:failed?'No fue posible procesar la consulta en lenguaje natural en este momento.':rawAnswer}}];
